items.quote: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank
items.claim: Some people ignored Moses's instruction and kept part of it until morning, and what they kept went bad: it bred worms and stank.
items.actor: some of them (those addressed by Moses)
items.action: left of it until the morning, disregarding Moses
items.object: it (the item referred to in the preceding text; the passage itself does not name it)
items.mechanism: Food kept overnight against instruction spoiled (bred worms, stank)

items.quote: and Moses was wroth with them
items.claim: Moses was angry with the people who disobeyed his instruction and kept it until morning.
items.object: them (those who left of it until the morning)
